thread:
jess: Hey — my promo code returns 'invalid' when I try to apply it during checkout after I updated my billing card. It was supposed to give 3 months free.
support_amy: Sorry about that, can you share the account email and a screenshot or the exact API response? We can escalate.
jess: sure — email is jess@acme.com. API response below:
```
POST /v1/promos/claim
{ "code": "SPRINGPLUS50", "account_id": "acct_az9" }
Response 400
{"error":"promo_invalid","message":"code expired or not eligible","promo_state":"active","eligible_countries":["US","CA"]}
```
support_amy: interesting — promo_state shows active but API marked invalid. Do you know your billing country on the account now?
jess: i updated billing last night to a NZ card (currency NZD). previously it was US.
billing_mike: tagging in — looking at stripe events now. quick log snippet:
```
promo_apply: account=acct_az9, country=NZ, currency=NZD, promo.allowed_countries=[US,CA], promo.allowed_currencies=[USD], result=fail
```
billing_mike: looks like validation is checking currency whitelist too; this should have fallen back to country-based eligibility but it didn't.
eng_ryan: thanks for the data. we deployed a config tweak last week that tightened currency checks. bug: promos with allowed_countries but no explicit allowed_currencies get treated as expired for non-USD billing. we'll hotfix.
support_amy: for now we can manually whitelist the promo for jess@acme.com and issue the credit. want me to apply a $75 manual credit and mark the promo as redeemed on the account?
jess: yes please, that would be great. do i need to switch my billing back to US to redeem?
billing_mike: no, don't switch. we'll apply the manual credit and follow up when engineering rolls the fix so future claims work normally.
ops_bot: Deploy notice: deploy 2026-02-15T03:24:11Z promo-service patch v1.4.2 -> canary (promo validation currency fallback)
eng_ryan: created TKT-4321 for the root fix and added logs + replay steps. assigning to eng-ml to verify regressions.
support_amy: manual credit queued, email receipt will be sent to jess@acme.com within 10–15 minutes. closing the immediate issue but will update this thread when the fix is live. :thumbsup:
jess: awesome, thank you everyone! much appreciated.
